images.title: Regroup to add LXXXVII and LXXVIII
images.purpose: Shows the pooled symbols of LXXXVII and LXXVIII regrouped into CLXV.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Before and after: on the left the pooled symbol tiles sorted in rows, a large arrow, and on the right the four tiles of the answer.
images.exact_structure: Left: square tiles (white fill, dark outline, dark letters) in four rows: row 1 exactly 2 tiles L; row 2 exactly 5 tiles X; row 3 exactly 2 tiles V; row 4 exactly 5 tiles I. One thick amber (#E69F00) arrow points right, labelled regroup above it. Right: one row of exactly 4 tiles with teal (#0072B2) outlines: C, L, X, V. Exactly 18 tiles in all. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: Five I's make V, two V's make X, five X's make L, two L's make C: the sum is CLXV.
